domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of facizers where I need to arrange the facizers into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a facizer
   Unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer
   Put down a facizer
   Stack a facizer on top of another facizer

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one facizer at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a facizer if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a facizer if the facizer is on the table and the facizer is clear. A facizer is clear if the facizer has no other facizers on top of it and if the facizer is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unstacking was really on top of the other facizer.
   I can only unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unstacking is clear.
   Once I pick up or unstack a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
   I can only put down a facizer that I am holding.
   I can only stack a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being stacked.
   I can only stack a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am stacking the facizer is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

   I am playing with a set of willets where I need to arrange the willets into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a willet
   Unstack a willet from on top of another willet
   Put down a willet
   Stack a willet on top of another willet

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one willet at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a willet if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a willet if the willet is on the table and the willet is clear. A willet is clear if the willet has no other willets on top of it and if the willet is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a willet from on top of another willet if the willet I am unstacking was really on top of the other willet.
   I can only unstack a willet from on top of another willet if the willet I am unstacking is clear.
   Once I pick up or unstack a willet, I am holding the willet.
   I can only put down a willet that I am holding.
   I can only stack a willet on top of another willet if I am holding the willet being stacked.
   I can only stack a willet on top of another willet if the willet onto which I am stacking the willet is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a willet, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a willet on top of a second willet, the second willet is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of rontresses where I need to arrange the rontresses into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a rontress
   Unstack a rontress from on top of another rontress
   Put down a rontress
   Stack a rontress on top of another rontress

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one rontress at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a rontress if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a rontress if the rontress is on the table and the rontress is clear. A rontress is clear if the rontress has no other rontresses on top of it and if the rontress is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a rontress from on top of another rontress if the rontress I am unstacking was really on top of the other rontress.
   I can only unstack a rontress from on top of another rontress if the rontress I am unstacking is clear.
   Once I pick up or unstack a rontress, I am holding the rontress.
   I can only put down a rontress that I am holding.
   I can only stack a rontress on top of another rontress if I am holding the rontress being stacked.
   I can only stack a rontress on top of another rontress if the rontress onto which I am stacking the rontress is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a rontress, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a rontress on top of a second rontress, the second rontress is no longer clear.

   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.

   I am playing with a set of magnifians where I need to arrange the magnifians into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a magnifian
   Unstack a magnifian from on top of another magnifian
   Put down a magnifian
   Stack a magnifian on top of another magnifian

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one magnifian at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a magnifian if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a magnifian if the magnifian is on the table and the magnifian is clear. A magnifian is clear if the magnifian has no other magnifians on top of it and if the magnifian is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a magnifian from on top of another magnifian if the magnifian I am unstacking was really on top of the other magnifian.
   I can only unstack a magnifian from on top of another magnifian if the magnifian I am unstacking is clear.
   Once I pick up or unstack a magnifian, I am holding the magnifian.
   I can only put down a magnifian that I am holding.
   I can only stack a magnifian on top of another magnifian if I am holding the magnifian being stacked.
   I can only stack a magnifian on top of another magnifian if the magnifian onto which I am stacking the magnifian is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a magnifian, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a magnifian on top of a second magnifian, the second magnifian is no longer clear.
